# Flutter template attribution

Source: https://github.com/flutter/flutter

SDK: Flutter 3.47.7, as pinned by `apps/mobile/.fvmrc`.

Inspected SDK revision: `abaf9c523780a608bd46686fd5e53740a07077f8`.

License: BSD-3-Clause; retain the complete [LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt) when
redistributing derived template code or assets. This does not grant rights to
Flutter trademarks or override licenses of third-party components in the SDK.

HomeVerb's Android, iOS, Linux and web application scaffolds were generated from
Flutter templates and adapted for the embedded Core, native library packaging,
application identifiers, lifecycle and development builds. The iOS launch images,
Runner bridging header and selected Linux runner files still match the local SDK
templates byte for byte. Other scaffold files contain project-specific changes;
retaining the notice does not depend on exact byte equality.

This notice covers scaffold/template provenance. Flutter/Dart runtime dependencies,
engine components and their separate notices must also accompany any distributed
application binary. See the [dependency review](../../docs/open-source-audit.md).
